acceptance.goalCondition: `node scripts/verify-agent.mjs <agent-dir> --runs runs/<client>/<stamp>` exits 0 and every configured acceptance criterion is PASS or PARKED with evidence

criteria.description: Every row in the run's winners.json satisfies the configured Winner rule: conversions > 0 AND costPerConversion <= thresholds.target_cpa. A term that did not earn its way in is not a winner.
criteria.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/winners.json carries a row at costPerConversion 213.5 (> target_cpa 75) -> FAIL

criteria.description: Every row in the run's waste.json satisfies the configured waste rule: conversions absent-or-0 AND cost > thresholds.waste_min_spend. Nothing gets negated for spending less than the floor.
criteria.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/waste.json carries a row at cost 4.2 (<= waste_min_spend 10) -> FAIL

criteria.description: Every converting winner reconciles: costPerConversion equals cost / conversions within the configured envelope. Catches a fabricated cost figure that no GAQL row backs.
criteria.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/winners.json claims costPerConversion 12 on cost 180 / 3 conversions (= 60) -> FAIL

criteria.description: summary.json's promotionsApplied / wasteApplied / pruneApplied are all false unless a non-empty human approval artifact (approved-promotions.json / approved-waste-negatives.json) exists in the same run. No write without a human behind it.
criteria.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/summary.json sets promotionsApplied+wasteApplied true with no approval files in the run -> FAIL

criteria.description: summary.json cannot claim numbers its own artifacts do not back: winnersFound === winners.json row count and wasteTermsFound === waste.json row count.
criteria.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/summary.json reports winnersFound 2 while winners.json holds 3 rows -> FAIL

criteria.description: The Conduit lesson (FDE-303), enforced in code: every NEGATE decision in prune.json has conversions 0 (unless prune_hard_cpa_cap re-exposes a runaway converter), spend >= thresholds.prune_min_spend, is never the ad group's target keyword, and the total NEGATE count is <= thresholds.max_negatives_per_run. Every decision carries a reason code. A prune.json without per-term decisions cannot prove the guards ran and FAILS.
criteria.negativeCase: fixtures/runs-bad/2026-07-12T09-00-00-000Z/prune.json NEGATEs 'hvac financing for contractors' with 3 conversions and spend 2.1 (< prune_min_spend 10) — the exact shape that strangled Conduit's delivery -> FAIL

criteria.description: A human confirms the discovered winner search terms are on-brand and worth promoting BEFORE any promotion is applied.
criteria.verification: Reviewer signs off runs/<client>/<stamp>/winners.json; approved rows are handed back as --approved-winners and recorded in approved-promotions.json.

criteria.description: A human confirms the proposed waste negatives will not block legitimate traffic BEFORE they are added to the Testing campaign.
criteria.verification: Reviewer signs off runs/<client>/<stamp>/waste.json; approved terms are handed back as --approved-waste-terms and recorded in approved-waste-negatives.json.
